lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in loose vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical white bands that intersect with circular blobs, creating a discernible grid-like pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature along the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense patterning of small white spots on the snout region, which increases in spot size and spacing moving posteriorly towards the gills.
